## Three files, one kit

1. `walk.mjs` exports `walk(dirs)` → `{ x, y }` from the origin.
2. `scrub.mjs` exports `scrubLog(text)` → unique trimmed sorted names.
3. `main.mjs` imports both, prints `walk` of east×3+south×2 as `3,2`, then a space, then `scrubLog` of `b\na\nb` (`a\nb`).

Write a short Why below: why `walk` is testable without the stage.
